subtitle: Turning a stored Connection into a real, usable connection

code:
from airflow.providers.snowflake.hooks.snowflake import SnowflakeHook

hook = SnowflakeHook(snowflake_conn_id="snowflake_default")
df = hook.get_pandas_df("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders;")
caption: Real SQL against real Snowflake — the Hook resolved the conn_id into a session.
The Operator exists so you rarely have to write this yourself.
